texts.li: [loan,!late,!lowtech] {ENEMY} are on the comms about the loan. Everything the colony landed with was bought with their money, and the {COUNT} silver it owes them is now due. They're very polite about it, for now.

[loan,!late,lowtech] A rider of {ENEMY} has come to the gate with a ledger under one arm. The colony's debt of {COUNT} silver is due, and the rider would like it paid. {ENEMY} are polite about these things, the first time.
[loan,late,!lowtech] {ENEMY} are back on the comms about the debt, now {COUNT} silver with their interest. They're noticeably less polite this time.
[loan,late,lowtech] The rider of {ENEMY} is back at the gate, ledger and all. With their interest, the colony now owes {COUNT} silver, and the rider has stopped smiling.

[heist,boss,!late,!lowtech] {X_nameDef} of {ENEMY} has found the colony. The message is short: {COUNT} silver was taken from {X_objective}, and {X_pronoun} wants every coin of it back. Pay, and {X_pronoun} might call it square. Don't, and {X_pronoun} will come and take it.

[heist,boss,!late,lowtech] A rider in the colors of {ENEMY} brings a message from {X_nameDef}: {COUNT} silver was taken from {X_objective}, and {X_pronoun} wants every coin of it back. Pay, and {X_pronoun} might call it square. Don't, and {X_pronoun} will come and take it.

[heist,!boss] Word comes from {ENEMY}: the {COUNT} silver the colony is carrying was taken from one of their own, and they want every coin of it back. Pay, and they might call it square. Don't, and they'll come and take it.
[heist,boss,late] {X_nameDef} is back for the rest of the money, {COUNT} silver of it now, interest included. The message ends: "I've been patient. Ask anyone. I'm known for it."

li.label: Pay the {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: The silver is handed over, every coin of it. {ENEMY} take it and go, and the debt is finally settled.

li.label: Pay half now and ask for more time
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} hands over half the silver and a great many promises. {ENEMY} agree to wait. The rest will cost more when they come back for it.

li.label: Refuse to pay
li.outcome: The answer is no. {ENEMY} will come for what they're owed within a day or so, and they'll keep coming.

li.label: {ENEMY} want their money
li.text: The colony wouldn't pay what it owes {ENEMY}. They've come to take it.
